name: FRC 25
storyline:
Fut Rap Cartas is a digital collectible card game set in the world of freestyle rap battles. Players build their own roster of battle rappers, each represented through unique cards inspired by real-life performers and competitive attributes.

Through strategic deck building, users simulate rap clashes where skills such as punchlines, flow, staging, and crowd control determine the outcome. The game blends hip-hop culture with competitive gameplay, allowing players to relive iconic battle dynamics while creating their own path within the freestyle scene.

Since its release, Fut Rap Cartas has grown into a global community-driven experience, connecting rap fans and gamers through digital competition and collection mechanics.
summary: Fut Rap Cards (FRC) is a collectible card app based on freestyle rap.
